claims.claim: Jiang says he does not keep written notebooks or computer notes; instead he stores potential story lines in memory and waits to see whether they escalate before committing them to long-term attention.
He presents memory-based filtering as a way to preserve intellectual flexibility, arguing that not writing everything down lets him keep more freedom in how patterns later connect.
Jiang says Twitter analysis requires separating what is actually newsworthy from clickbait and from AI-generated fabricated content.
He dismisses the Elon Musk claim about Congress hiding the U.S.-Israel military relationship in the defense bill as made-up noise rather than a usable signal.

Jiang identifies China-Japan-Philippines maritime delimitation as a real conflict track worth watching and predicts that China and Japan will eventually go kinetic over South China Sea shipping lanes.
He says the emerging maritime conflict matters because Japan is abandoning strategic ambiguity and moving toward a clearer confrontation over territorial waters and shipping encroachment.

signature_moments.moment: Jiang's archive is almost entirely mental: he keeps story lines in short-term memory until events prove they deserve promotion.
signature_moments.source_phrase: I basically put the news item in short-term memory
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It is one of the cleanest method disclosures in the source and explains how he builds patterns without visible notebooks.

signature_moments.moment: He claims to have trained his mind into a detector that spots the difference between signal and manufactured AI noise.
signature_moments.source_phrase: I've turned my mind to be able to spot the difference
signature_moments.why_it_matters: This preserves the packet's central self-description of judgment as a cultivated perceptual skill.

signature_moments.moment: Among the feed clutter, the line Jiang decides to keep is stark: at some point China and Japan will go kinetic over the shipping lanes.
signature_moments.source_phrase: at some point, China and Japan will go kinetic
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It captures how his live feed triage converts noisy snippets into a concrete war forecast.
